name: M'uru / Entropius
shortDescription: M'uru / Entropius, represented in the Shattered Sun and Sunwell research story.
body: The encounter's darkened, diminished naaru form, shown as the transformation named by Velen in the original raid epilogue; later M'uru material is excluded. Original image-generation art; not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, size or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the Burning Crusade patch-2.4 client/model before human review. See docs/research/shattered-sun-sunwell-visual-assets.json.
